title: Child safety: screening and supervision in sessions
audience: Tutors and learning-support staff who work with children and young people, in person or online
learningOutcomes: Confirm that screening required for child-related work is held before any contact with a learner
Apply the supervision rules for sessions in person and online
Recognise the boundaries that protect both the learner and the tutor

instruction.heading: Screening before contact
instruction.body: Before a tutor has contact with a child, the business checks that the tutor holds any screening required for child-related work in the state or territory where the sessions happen. Screening schemes, their names and their rules differ by state and territory, and some apply to the tutor personally rather than to the business. The business keeps a record of the check and its expiry date. A check that has expired, or that the tutor has not yet obtained, means the tutor does not have contact with learners. UNCONFIRMED: no official source has been fetched for this point in this draft. A child-safety reviewer must confirm it before approval. Completing this lesson does not give a working-with-children check, registration, certificate or authority to work with children.

instruction.heading: Supervision in person
instruction.body: Sessions are held where the business has set a policy. The policy may require the session to be in an open space, in view of others, with a parent or guardian present or within reach. A tutor does not arrange one-to-one sessions in a private room, a car or a bedroom unless the business policy allows it and the record shows the arrangement. The tutor does not give gifts, does not offer rides and does not arrange meetings outside the agreed session time.

instruction.heading: Supervision online
instruction.body: Online sessions use the business platform, not personal social media or a private messaging app. The parent or guardian is told when the session starts and can see the session where the policy requires. The tutor does not record a session, take a screenshot of a learner or share a learner's work outside the business without written consent. Communication with a learner is limited to agreed hours and channels.

procedure: Check the tutor's required screening is held and in date before any contact with a learner
Record the screening type, the expiry date and the check of it
Set the session location against the business policy: open, in view, or with a parent or guardian present
For online sessions, use the business platform and tell the parent or guardian when the session starts
End any contact that breaks the policy and record the reason

workedExamples.situation: A learner asks the tutor to continue the session in the tutor's car after the library closes, and offers to pay for the ride.
workedExamples.reasoning: The car is a private place outside the agreed session location, and a ride is not part of the service. The tutor declines, ends the arrangement in the agreed way, tells the business, and records the request. The tutor does not agree to the ride to avoid an awkward moment.

equipmentAndPpe: Screening record with type, expiry date and check date
Written session location and supervision policy
Business online platform account, with session logs turned on where the policy requires

commonErrors.error: Starting work with a learner before a required check is confirmed.
commonErrors.prevention: Check the record before the first contact. Do not start while a check is missing or expired.

commonErrors.error: Arranging a private one-to-one session without the policy allowing it.
commonErrors.prevention: Use the location in the policy. Ask the business before any change.

commonErrors.error: Messaging a learner on a personal app outside the agreed hours and channels.
commonErrors.prevention: Use the business channel and the agreed hours only.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: Screening requirements, their names and the people they apply to differ by state and territory. UNCONFIRMED: no official source has been fetched for this point in this draft. A child-safety reviewer must confirm it before approval.
Completing this lesson does not give a working-with-children check, registration, certificate or authority to work with children.
Supervision rules in this lesson are the business minimum. A reviewer must confirm them and the business may set stricter rules.

qualityStandard: Every tutor's required screening is recorded with its expiry date before first contact
Each session location matches the written supervision policy
Online sessions use only the business platform and agreed hours
documentationEvidence: Screening record with expiry date and check date
Record of any declined arrangement or policy breach
summary: Screening is checked and in date before any contact with a learner
Sessions follow the written supervision policy in person and online
Private arrangements, gifts and personal channels are declined and recorded

knowledgeChecks.question: When must a tutor's screening be confirmed for child-related work?
options: Before any contact with a learner

knowledgeChecks.question: A learner asks to move a session into a private room with the door closed. What does the tutor do?
options: Use the location in the written policy and ask the business before any change
Agree if the parent is on the phone

knowledgeChecks.question: Which channel is correct for communicating with a learner about a session?
options: The business channel, within the agreed hours
A private messaging app at any time
